ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity ratio; predominantly dark-spectrum pixels (90%+) with localized high-intensity specular highlights and sparse white mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Sparse, high-contrast white circular spots (mottling) are distributed across the mid-region of both lobes and concentrated near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees, extending deeply into the central fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (approx. 2-5 pixel depth) distributed continuously along the trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a broad concave arc from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edge (visible at tips) shows a convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white/grey pixel groups located at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with localized scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, textured tan-colored protrusions (biological clusters) attached to the outer distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
